newsitem.title: USA: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.
newsitem.headline: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.

text.p: High cotton prices have triggered another special quota permitting entry of 45,099,152 kilograms (99,426,691 lbs), the U.S. Department of Agriculture said Thursday.
The quota, being established on May 1, 1997, applies to cotton purchased not later than July 29, 1997 and entered into the United States not later than Oct. 27, 1997, USDA said.
The quota amount is for the period Oct 1996 through Dec 1996.
